chunks: And from his sermon (peace be upon him), he glorifies Allah, the Exalted, mentions the Quran and the Prophet, and exhorts the people.
ai.seo_question: What are the main elements of Imam Ali's sermons according to this excerpt from Nahj al-Balagha?
ai.summary: This excerpt encapsulates the tripartite foundation of Imam Ali’s (AS) khutbahs in Nahj al-Balagha, where divine transcendence (Tawhid), scriptural authority (Quran), and prophetic precedent (Nubuwwah) converge to guide the community. Sharif al-Radi’s compilation presents this as a model of rhetorical precision, reflecting the Shia scholarly view that Ali’s sermons serve as both theological exposition and practical moral instruction for the Ummah.
